status: source-supported proposals only; root reconciles and applies source edits
scope: All12 refrain огонь/орёл opening vowels plus seven specified related sonorants.
method: Original stereo waveform/spectrogram authority, zero-lag estimated stem identity support, competing MMS character ownership and Whisper timing; no constant shift.
signalResolution: 512 or1024 samples Hann support,88-sample hop (2.0ms); displayed sample points encode chosen boundaries, not that physical precision.
limits: Continuous adjacent vowels and quiet nasal ownership remain uncertain; signal intervals describe plausible splits, not calibrated statistical confidence.
Estimated stem leaks/reverb and noncausal separation are possible; stem paths alone are insufficient.
Restricted and whole-phrase MMS share a model family. Conditioned Whisper is not lexical confirmation. Unprompted short-crop failures are retained and rejected.
No changes to neutral line visibility, direct-body final releases, lyric inventory, or source media are proposed here.
